newsitem.title: USA: Emisphere files for 2.5 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Emisphere files for 2.5 mln common shares.

text.p: Emisphere Technologies Inc filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.5 million common shares.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 12,020,596 common shares, according to the filing.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 375,000 additional common share. The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Robertson, Stephens & Co and Gensis Merchant Group Securities.
Proceeds will be used to fund continued research and development, increase in manufacturing capacity and for general corporate purposes, among others.
Emisphere, based in Hawthorne, N.Y., is a drug delivery company focused on the discovery and application of proprietary synthethic chemical compounds.
